items.title: Sound perception and word recognition
items.expectation: Interpret fine phonological detail, marked delivery, and subtle prosodic meaning across demanding input.
items.exit_boundary: Precise articulation and prosody enhance subtle meaning; retained accent does not reduce intelligibility or effectiveness.
